propositions: Dependabot PRs #123 and #124 cannot merge on GitHub (read-only mirror); must be re-landed as Gerrit changes and closed by hand.
PR #123 bumps setup-python from v6 to v7 and re-pins pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish across 13 workflow files; v7 requires node24 runner and migrated to ESM.

PR #124 upgrades mcp from 1.29.0 to 2.0.0 (major) and ruff from 0.15.22 to 0.16.1; mcp v1 API paths (FastMCP, auth.settings, auth.provider, transport_security, ToolAnnotations) are imported in rebar-mcp and may be removed as non-compat in v2.
A P0 pip-audit vulnerability (click 8.2.1 PYSEC-2026-2132) gates all Verified CI runs and must be unblocked via a Change 0 that lands first, upgrading click to >=8.3.3 in uv.lock only.

Change A applies PR #123 verbatim; Change B either upgrades mcp to 2.0 with full compat validation plus updates to _optionality.yml and ADR 0050, or retains mcp <2 and defers v2 migration to a follow-up ticket with evidence recorded.
Both PRs must be closed on GitHub with comments naming their Gerrit changes after merge; the decision evidence (test results, import errors) for the mcp v2 decision must be recorded on the ticket.
